activity_summary: Verbeke came home early by the back wall, his cap in his hand. Mistress Ansell acted before the talk could start. She put him in the lumber garret over your chamber with a jug and a pot. She swore the household on her Bible, you first. If any ask, the back room is let to a man from Norwich. She said he was from Norwich tonight, and that he had always had a Norwich face. You said it. Alse said it. He said it. She would not have the latch changed. Nobody came.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Swore first, and kept the sentence as she gave it.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Hid him before anyone discussed it, and took the oath.

entities.name: Gillis Verbeke
entities.context: Came by the wall, said Norwich, and went up.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Set the jug and the pot, swore, and did not change the latch.

facets.activity: Swore the back room is let to a man from Norwich

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: Master Verbeke is from Norwich tonight, if anybody asks. He has always had a Norwich face.
